issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַיְקִימֵנִי לוֹ לְמַטָּרָה' means 'He set me up as His target' (i.e., a mark for His arrows), but the Chinese renders it as '祂為我設立監獄' ('He established a prison for me'), which introduces the concept of a prison not present in the Hebrew and omits the meaning of being set as a target.
